T: One last ride. One good dinner.
D: An ageing Logan cares for a frail Charles Xavier and protects a young girl being hunted.
P: Serve the mains when the Munson family invite them in for dinner.
S: the hideout near the Mexican border
Beef chuck braised with dried chillies, garlic and cumin until it shreds, in warm corn tortillas with white onion, coriander and lime.
Gas station corn dogs with mustard
the long limo run north towards Eden

Frankfurts dipped in a sweet cornmeal batter and fried golden and crunchy on sticks, with yellow mustard and tomato sauce for dunking. Pat 8 frankfurts dry, skewer each on a stick and dust in flour. Whisk 150g fine polenta, 150g plain flour, 2 tbsp sugar, 2 tsp baking powder and 1 tsp salt with 1 egg and 250ml buttermilk into a thick batter, then pour into a tall glass. Dip each frankfurt to coat and fry at 180C for 3 to 4 minutes, turning, until deep golden. Drain and serve with mustard and tomato sauce.
the corn growing on the Munson farm
Fresh corn cut off the cob folded into a batter of flour, egg, milk, spring onion and chilli, fried in spoonfuls until golden. Sour cream.
M: the one good dinner the Munsons share
Pan-fried pork chops with apple and onion gravy, mashed potato and green beans. Season 4 pork chops and pan-fry 4 minutes a side.
Casino hotel rib eye with peppercorn sauce
the casino hotel where they stop for a night

Dry-brined rib eye seared hard and butter-basted, with a creamy green peppercorn and brandy sauce, crisp fries and a wedge salad. Salt 4 rib eye steaks and leave uncovered in the fridge overnight. Bake 800g frozen fries at 220C for 25 minutes. Sear the steaks in a smoking pan for 3 minutes a side, then add 40g butter, garlic and thyme and baste for 1 minute. Rest 5 minutes. In the same pan add 1 diced shallot and 1 tbsp crushed green peppercorns, then 40ml brandy, 150ml beef stock and 150ml cream and reduce 3 minutes. Serve with fries and iceberg wedges with ranch.
W: Peaches with brown sugar, cinnamon and cornflour in a lattice pie, baked at 190C for 50 minutes. Vanilla ice cream.
K: Logan's bourbon and smoked maple sour
the bottle Logan always has close

Bourbon shaken with fresh lemon, maple syrup and egg white until foamy, served over a big cube with a pinch of smoked salt and an orange twist. For each drink, dry shake 60ml bourbon, 25ml lemon juice, 15ml maple syrup and half an egg white for 10 seconds, then add ice and shake hard for 15 seconds. Strain over a large ice cube in a heavy glass. Add a tiny pinch of smoked salt on the foam and twist orange peel over the top.

s.note: the hideout near the Mexican border
s.how: Braise 800g beef chuck with 3 soaked dried chillies, 3 garlic cloves and 1 tsp cumin for 3 hours until it shreds. Serve in 16 warm corn tortillas with white onion, coriander and lime.

s.note: the corn growing on the Munson farm
s.how: Cut the kernels off 3 corn cobs. Whisk 120g flour, 2 eggs and 125ml milk, then fold in the corn, 2 spring onions and a chopped chilli. Fry spoonfuls until golden and serve with sour cream.

m.note: the one good dinner the Munsons share
m.how: Season 4 pork chops and pan-fry 4 minutes a side. Fry 1 sliced onion and 1 sliced apple in the pan, add 300ml chicken stock and 1 tsp mustard and reduce. Serve with 800g potatoes mashed with butter and 300g steamed green beans.

w.how: Toss 6 sliced peaches with 100g brown sugar, 1 tsp cinnamon and 2 tbsp cornflour. Line a dish with 2 sheets sweet shortcrust, fill and weave a lattice from 2 more. Bake at 190C for 50 minutes. Serve with ice cream.

d.n: Logan's bourbon and smoked maple sour
d.note: the bottle Logan always has close
d.how: For each drink, dry shake 60ml bourbon, 25ml lemon juice, 15ml maple syrup and half an egg white for 10 seconds, then add ice and shake hard for 15 seconds. Strain over a large ice cube in a heavy glass. Add a tiny pinch of smoked salt on the foam and twist orange peel over the top.
